# Get Product Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given product.

## Syntax

~~~~text
productDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, product: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
productDetail(detail: # of Ratings, product: Jellycuts)
~~~~
